scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,desktop "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/desktop"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n server,web "npm run dev -w packages/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w apps/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w apps/desktop
scripts.e2e:build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run e2e
